0x80014D3C.name: task_sleep
0x80014D3C.note: yield the current game task for a0 frames (overridden: src/game/overrides/tasks.cpp)

0x80014E24.name: playtime_tick
0x80014E24.note: increments the u32 play-time counter at game_data + 0x24 every frame. Conf H

0x80029EF4.name: gfx_packet_pool_full
0x80029EF4.note: 1 when the frame's 28-byte sprite packet pool (ptr 801D9714) has reached its end (exact compare)

0x8002FD64.name: game_data_init
0x8002FD64.note: clears/initialises the game data block at boot and new game. Conf M

0x800484AC.name: collection_clear_new
0x800484AC.note: clears the 0x20 'new' flag of collection bytes (andi 0xDF). Conf H

0x8004850C.name: collection_add_card
0x8004850C.note: (player, card, count): collection byte at game_data + player*10040 + 0x1482 + card; count = low 3 bits, capped at 6 (flag 0x10 full, 0x50/0x56), 0x20 'new' on a first copy; refuses cards 172-190 (returns -3). Write watch: adds battle rewards. Conf H

0x80048D68.name: battle_rewards_pick
0x80048D68.note: writes the battle's reward card numbers as u16 at game_data + 0x272C (save 0x292C), 0xFFFF = none. Conf H

0x80049280.name: battle_rewards_grant
0x80049280.note: calls collection_add_card for the picked rewards; writes game_data + 0x2732.. Conf M

0x8004BE48.name: digipart_give
0x8004BE48.note: (player, part): sets bit part%8 of game_data + player*10040 + 0x3C + part/8. Conf H

0x8004C010.name: digipart_has
0x8004C010.note: (player, part): tests the same bit. Conf H

0x801ED8D0.name: title_draw_sprite
0x801ED8D0.note: (x, y, vram_x, vram_y, w, h, clut_x, clut_y, depth, semi, semi_mode, brightness, ot_layer): DR_MODE + SPRT packet into the pool

0x801EE850.name: title_init
0x801EE850.note: loads B:TITLE.ARC and uploads each TIM at its own VRAM position

0x801F7600.name: partner_gain_exp
0x801F7600.note: adds partner EXP (u16 game_data + 0x2FA) and raises the level (u8 game_data + 0x2F9) after a battle. Conf M

0x801FCF78.name: battle_counters_add
0x801FCF78.note: after a battle: for 32 slots whose battle flag is set, u16 counter+1 at game_data + 0x818 + 2*i (capped at 999). Not the Digi parts; role not known (maybe wins per opponent). Conf M
